title: Western Blot Protocol
author: Payal Patel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfiijkce
materials: Soaked sponges and transfer paper in Transfer Buffer
Soak fiber pads thoroughly in a Transfer Buffer
Electrotransfer to PVDF membrane at 30 mV Overnight

steps.title: Culture Cell Growth
steps.instruction: Grow cells in 50 mL of TSB and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Distribute the culture into centrifuge tubes and pellet the cells.

substeps.instruction: Distribute 17 mL of culture into two 50 mL centrifuge tubes and 10 mL into one 20 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge for 20 minutes at 4300 rpm (4303 xg) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate media from cultures and wash cells 3 times with TE aspirate.

steps.title: Lyse Cells with Buffer A
steps.instruction: Lyse cells by resuspending in 1 mL of Lysis Buffer A.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Lysis Buffer A: 20 mM Tris Cl, 15 mM NaCl, 0.9696% Triton pH 7.5, Phosphatase Inhibitor (50 mM NaF, 1 mM Sodium Orthovanadate, 10 mM Sodium Pyrophosphate, and 10 mM B-glycerophosphate), and EDTA-free Protease tablet (1 tablet per 10 mL).
Centrifuge at 13000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Lyse Cells with Buffer B
steps.instruction: Lyse cells by resuspending in 1 mL of Lysis Buffer B.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Lysis Buffer B: 1% SDS, 10 mL Tris Cl, 1 mM EDTA, Phosphatase Inhibitor (50 mM NaF, 1 mM Sodium Orthovanadate, 10 mM Sodium Pyrophosphate, and 10 mM B-glycerophosphate), and EDTA-free Protease tablet (1 tablet per 10 mL).
Sonicate for 1 minute; repeat 5 times.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Loading
steps.instruction: Combine cell lysates with Laemmli buffer.

substeps.instruction: Combine 40 µL 4X Laemmli to cell lysate, 40 µL of Lysis A, and 40 µL of Lysis B.

steps.title: Load SDS-PAGE Gel
steps.instruction: Load samples and ladder onto the gel.

substeps.instruction: Load 40 µL of sample onto SDS-PAGE gel.
Load 40 µL of All Blue Precision Plus for ladder.

steps.title: Assemble Transfer Sandwich
steps.instruction: Assemble the transfer cassette components in the following order, rolling out air bubbles between each layer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 cm depth of Transfer Buffer to container and insert plastic cassette with black side down.
Lay a wet fiber pad on the black side of the cassette.
Lay one wet blotting paper on the fiber pad.
Lay gel squarely on blotting paper.
Lay wet PVDF on the gel.
Lay one wet blotting paper on the membrane.
Lay a wet fiber pad on top of the blotting paper.
Close the cassette and clamp together with the white clip.

steps.title: Wash and Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash and block the PVDF membrane after transfer.

substeps.instruction: Wash PVDF membrane with 25 mL TBS for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate membrane in 25 mL Blocking Buffer for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash three times for 5 minutes each with 15 mL TBST.
Incubate membrane in Primary Antibody (1:2000) in 10 mL Primary Antibody Dilution Buffer with gentle agitation overnight.
Wash three times for 5 minutes each with 15 mL TBST.
Incubate membrane with Anti-mouse IgG, HRP-linked Antibody (1:1000) in 10 mL Blocking Buffer with gentle agitation for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Detection and Imaging
steps.instruction: Develop the membrane using ECL reagent.

substeps.instruction: Wash three times for 5 minutes each with 15 mL TBST.
Prepare 1X SignalFire™ ECL Reagent (#6883) by diluting one part 2X Reagent A and one part 2X Reagent B (e.g., mix 1 mL of each).
Incubate substrate with membrane for 7 minutes.
Remove excess solution (keep membrane wet) and expose to X-ray film using an imager.
Combine 7.5 g Nonfat dry Milk with 150 mL TBST to make Blocking Buffer.
Combine 1.0 g 5% BSA to 20 mL 1X TBST and mix well.
